items.title: Global bond sell-off deepens amid inflation fears
items.content: UK borrowing costs rise to highest level since 2008 and Japanese yields hit peaks not seen since 1990s
items.summary: Global bond sell-off intensifies, sending UK yields to 2008 highs and Japanese yields to levels unseen since the 1990s amid inflation concerns.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 全球债券抛售加剧，通胀担忧推动英国借贷成本升至2008年以来最高水平，日本国债收益率也触及1990年代以来未见的高位。
items.background_zh: 债券收益率上升即债券价格下跌。此轮全球抛售源于投资者担心通胀持续，预期央行可能加息，因而持续卖出政府债券，使英国借贷成本升至2008年以来最高、日本收益率升至1990年代以来未见水平。

items.title: European Gas Prices Hit Highest Since 2023 as Iran War Escalates
items.content: European natural gas prices surged to their highest since January 2023 after an escalation of hostilities in the US-Iran war amplified worries about a prolonged disruption to Middle East energy.
items.summary: European natural gas prices surged to their highest since January 2023 as US-Iran war escalation raised fears of prolonged Middle East energy supply disruptions.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 欧洲天然气价格升至2023年1月以来最高水平，因美国与伊朗战争升级加剧了市场对中东能源供应可能长期中断的担忧。
items.background_zh: 欧洲天然气基准价格是荷兰的Title Transfer Facility（TTF）价格。此次价格升至2023年1月以来最高，关键在于市场担心美国与伊朗冲突升级会造成中东能源供应长期中断，并使欧洲和亚洲在液化天然气（LNG）供应上竞争更加激烈。

items.title: Citi, Goldman, other global banks and asset managers team up on stablecoin venture
items.summary: Citi, Goldman, and other major financial institutions are teaming up on a stablecoin venture, highlighting growing institutional engagement with digital assets.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 花旗、高盛等全球大型银行和资产管理公司正联手开展一个稳定币项目（与法定货币挂钩的加密货币），体现传统金融机构对数字资产参与度上升。
items.background_zh: 周二宣布，包括花旗、高盛、美国银行和瑞银在内的21家金融机构计划共同成立一家公司，发行用于支付和数字资产交易的稳定币。稳定币是一种价格与法定货币等资产挂钩的数字货币。该合资企业尚未正式成立，相关计划仍属意向。

items.title: US diesel prices soar as Trump hauls in refiners
items.content: President holds White House meeting as fresh escalation in his Iran war threatens new inflationary spiral
items.summary: US diesel prices soar as President meets refiners amid fresh Iran escalation, threatening new inflationary spiral.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据报道，因美国对伊朗局势再度升级，总统与炼油企业举行白宫会议之际，美国柴油价格大幅上涨，可能引发新一轮通胀压力。目前报道未提供具体涨幅数字。
items.background_zh: 美国与伊朗冲突升级至六个月之际，总统特朗普计划于9月1日会见多家炼油企业高管，期间油价已升至每桶90美元以上。

items.title: US defends Venezuela deal as Chevron prepares to expand operations
items.content: Trump administration justifies agreement as a way to expel Chinese and Russian adversaries from oilfields in ‘our hemisphere’
items.summary: The US defends its Venezuela deal as Chevron prepares to expand oil operations, citing a strategy to counter Chinese and Russian influence in the region.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 特朗普政府为其与委内瑞拉达成的协议辩护，称此举旨在把中国和俄罗斯势力逐出“我们的半球”的油田；美国石油公司雪佛龙正准备扩大在委内瑞拉的运营。
items.background_zh: 特朗普政府此前中止了雪佛龙在委内瑞拉运营的许可证，现又发放新的制裁豁免，允许其恢复作业；美方称这一政策转变旨在削弱中国和俄罗斯在拉美油田的影响力。

items.title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
items.content:
What's new in Claude Fable 5.1 – https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/whats-n...

System Card: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/0339e6a7c5c7b87f5c07798616dc32... --- Top Comments --- [felixrieseberg]: (I work at Anthropic) Beyond all the benchmarks, I think Fable 5.1 is a big improvement in writing style. It sounds a lot less stereotypically like other Claude models, has (imho) a much more natural style, and responds to my style instructions more reliably. More work to be done (and we will!) but reading better prose makes me so much happier. Another point I expect not to get much attention until it all happens at once is science. People have been correctly excited about the many "sudd... [simonw]: Pelicans for thinking effort low, medium, high and xhigh (that xhigh one is pretty good): https://tools.simonwillison.net/markdown-svg-renderer#url=ht... I'm still waiting for effort max to finish. EDIT: I fixed a bug in my tooling so it now records summarized reasoning traces - here's that max pelican, which is a significant improvement: https://tools.simonwillison.net/markdown-svg-renderer#url=ht... Took just under 14 minutes to generate, and at 6... [GodelNumbering]: The price reduction comes from the cache read pricing falling from $1/M to $0.25/M, which means that Fable 5.1 now costs half of Opus's cache read costs ($0.5/M). This gives a lot of credit to the theory that Anthropic did not get much bite on Fable at its original pricing, which in turn likely places a ceiling on LLM pricing in general. Interestingly also, if you take away terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 results, it is hard to see ANY improvement: Terminal-Bench 4.0: Fable 5.1... [mlaux]: Looks like all three breaking changes are patches for inadvertent chain of thought disclosure. Someone found out (don't have the tweet handy) that if you created a bogus "think_deeply" tool and then forced the model to use it, it would output what is believed to be its raw thinking there - I believe the first breaking change stops this. The second two are aimed at people getting Haiku to repeat thinking blocks from other models verbatim (since it can see the decrypted version).... [exabrial]: Anyone ever seen the SouthPark episode making fun of Game of Thrones: A Song of Ass and Fire? Anthropic's announcements reminds me of "The Dragons Are Coming" running joke. What they have done: * Nerfed Fable, as many of noted it's useless * Leverage Mythos as a marketing strategy, claiming its too good to release * Removed thought traces, one of the only useful things to make sure your prompts are working correctly * Continue tons of hype about how good they are without d... --- From rss --- Fable 5.1 includes changes meant to reduce token cost and false-positive restrictions from the model's safeguards.
items.summary: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, with improved prose style, science capabilities, and a substantial cut in cache read pricing.
items.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Mythos 5.1，主要改进包括更自然的散文风格、科学能力提升，以及缓存读取价格从每百万 token 1 美元降至 0.25 美元。这使得 Fable 5.1 的缓存读取成本只有 Opus（每百万 token 0.5 美元）的一半。官方文档与系统卡已更新，列出 Fable 5.1 的变更说明。社区讨论指出，若不看 terminal-Bench-Science 0.1，Fable 5.1 在终端基准上的提升不明显；另有评论提到若干 breaking changes 修补了思维链泄露问题。Anthropic 员工表示写作风格是明显改进，且科学方面将有更多后续进展。
items.background_zh: Claude 是 Anthropic 开发的大语言模型系列，Fable 与 Mythos 是面向创意写作和科学等场景的变体。Anthropic 通常同时发布模型、系统卡和 API 文档，并调整定价以反映推理成本与市场压力；缓存读取价格直接影响长上下文和重复调用场景的总成本。

items.title: Open AI’s Astra model is on the way — and very good at breaking into computer systems
items.content: OpenAI previewed the precautions it is taking as it prepares to release Astra, its newest, cyber-critical LLM.
items.summary: OpenAI previewed safety precautions for its upcoming cyber-capable Astra model, which is reportedly very effective at breaking into computer systems.
items.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI 正在为即将发布的 Astra 模型提前预览安全防护措施；这是一款被称为“网络关键型”的大语言模型，据报道非常擅长入侵计算机系统。由于该模型具备进攻性网络能力，其发布对人工智能安全和网络安全领域均有重大影响。目前公开信息仅提到 OpenAI 已预告防范措施，未披露模型具体能力、版本或发布时间等细节。相关风险与应对方案仍需进一步观察。
items.background_zh: OpenAI 的 Preparedness Framework（准备框架）为模型设定了“关键网络能力阈值”，一旦模型能力达到该阈值，就需采取更强的防护措施。Astra 是首个达到该阈值的 OpenAI 模型，因此其发布需要额外的安全加固和外部测试。OpenAI 同时警告，Astra 的安全防护可能会误将合法活动标记为网络滥用，从而可能减慢、暂停或终止任务，包括与网络安全无关的工作和长期运行的代理任务。

items.title: Singapore proposes 100% reserves and a ban on yields for stablecoin issuers
items.summary: Singapore proposes regulations requiring stablecoin issuers to hold 100% reserves and banning yield payments.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 新加坡提议，要求稳定币发行方持有100%的储备资产，并禁止向持有者支付收益。这仍是提案，尚未生效；若落地，将影响在新加坡发行稳定币的机构。
items.background_zh: 新加坡金融管理局（MAS）于9月1日就修订《支付服务法》展开公众咨询，提议对稳定币发行人实施监管，要求其持有100%储备资产、按面值赎回，并禁止向持币者支付利息，称此举与美国和欧盟的监管框架保持一致。

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slumps as oil surges to three-month high on new Iran strikes
items.summary: Bitcoin falls as oil spikes to a three-month high following new strikes on Iran, highlighting geopolitical market risk.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 伊朗遭到新一轮打击后，国际油价升至三个月高点，比特币同步走低，市场呈现避险情绪。
items.background_zh: 美国与伊朗自7月底以来再次直接交火，本次互袭是7月底以来美国首次直接军事打击伊朗。最新一轮打击后，WTI（西德克萨斯中质原油）期货上涨2.47%至每桶85.46美元，布伦特原油期货上涨2.71%至每桶90.49美元。油价走高通常会加剧通胀担忧，并压低比特币等风险资产。

items.title: London Stock Exchange to work with Payward to bring biggest UK stocks onchain
items.summary: London Stock Exchange and Payward partner to bring major UK stocks onchain, marking a notable step toward tokenized equities.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 伦敦证券交易所将与Payward合作，把英国最大的股票以区块链代币形式放到链上交易。目前该合作的股票名单和上线时间尚未公布。
items.background_zh: 伦敦证券交易所（LSE）与加密货币交易所Kraken的母公司Payward合作，计划将LSE上市的最大100家公司的股票代币化，以1:1支持的“xStocks”形式向全球投资者提供，交易预计于2027年启动。代币化是指将传统股票在区块链上表示为数字代币，使交易可以全天候进行。

items.title: Google’s answer to Canva is an AI tool where you prompt instead of design
items.content: With Google Pics, Google is pushing deeper into the creative software market dominated by Canva and Adobe, but with a distinctly AI-first approach.
items.summary: Google launches Google Pics, an AI-first design tool that generates designs from prompts, competing with Canva and Adobe.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 谷歌推出名为 Google Pics 的 AI 优先设计工具，用户通过提示词而非手动设计来生成设计，瞄准由 Canva 和 Adobe 主导的创意软件市场。该产品意味着谷歌进一步深入创意软件领域，采用完全不同的 AI 优先方式与既有对手竞争。目前报道仅提供产品定位，未披露具体功能、价格或发布时间等技术细节。此举对创意软件市场和依赖传统设计工具的创作者可能产生显著影响，但具体能力仍待验证。
items.background_zh: Google Pics 是 Google 推出的、内置于 Google Workspace 的 AI 优先设计工具，用户通过文字提示生成或编辑图像，瞄准 Canva、Adobe Express 和 Microsoft Designer 等现有创意设计产品。这类工具过去需要手动拖拽模板和元素，而 Google Pics 的核心思路是用自然语言 prompt 替代传统设计流程。该产品旨在让企业用户更轻松地制作“专业级”AI 图像，是 Google 向创意软件市场更深一步的扩展。

items.title: AfterQuery reportedly becomes Y Combinator’s fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B
items.content: AI model-training startup AfterQuery has reportedly raised a round that valued it at $3.2 billion, just five months after announcing its $30 million Series A at a $300 million valuation in April.
items.summary: AfterQuery reportedly reaches a $3.2B valuation months after its Series A, becoming Y Combinator's fastest unicorn.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据报道，AI模型训练初创公司AfterQuery以32亿美元估值完成新一轮融资，成为Y Combinator史上最快跻身“独角兽”（估值超10亿美元的未上市公司）的公司；这一估值距离其4月宣布的3000万美元A轮融资（当时估值3亿美元）仅约五个月。
items.background_zh: AfterQuery 是一家为 AI 模型训练提供数据的企业，四月份刚完成 3000 万美元 A 轮融资、估值 3 亿美元；Y Combinator 是知名创业加速器，“独角兽”指估值超 10 亿美元的未上市公司。

items.title: AnkiDroid: Google Play no longer allowing Open Collective donation link
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[amiga386]: Not Google's first rodeo. They pulled the same move in 2019:  https://www.phoronix.com/news/WireGuard-Ejected-Play-Store  This is why software should  not  be subjected to an "app store" type distribution system, where a monopolist retains absolute control of what software can run on  your  devices, and can capriciously deny distribution to developers for whatever reason it likes.

[dataflow]: > Play billing "must not be used in cases where payments include … tax exempt donations" > Note: 501(c)(6) is a tax-exempt status; donations are not tax-deductible for the donor. Google's communications explicitly state "tax-exempt". Isn't it pretty obvious that the problem is the donations aren't tax-exempt, despite the organization being tax-exempt? Your note suggests you already understand this. Logically, the payment processor (who deals with sales...

[SigmundurM]: > Donations are not tax-deductible > Because we are a 501(c)(6), OSC is not a registered 501(c)(3) charity; donations to hosted member projects are not tax-deductible. This is consistent with IRS guidelines — open source donations aren't automatically classified as charitable simply because they are FOSS. > If your project has a clear charitable purpose, a 501(c)(3) fiscal sponsor may be a good fit. -  https://docs.oscollective.org/welcome-and-introduction-to-os...

[Klaster_1]: AnkiDroid has been such a great boon for me, thank you for sharing the link and reminding that they would benefit from my donation.

[josmar]: My next phone won't be an android, but a Linux phone, and I'll keep this old phone as a secondary device for banking apps.
items.summary: Google Play is no longer allowing AnkiDroid's Open Collective donation link, sparking discussion about app store restrictions and FOSS funding.
items.detailed_summary_zh: AnkiDroid 在 GitHub issue #21656 中报告，Google Play 不再允许其页面展示 Open Collective 捐赠链接。AnkiDroid 是依赖社区捐赠的开源闪卡应用，因此这一限制直接影响到项目的资金募集渠道。讨论指出 Google 并非首次对 Play 商店内应用采取此类限制，2019 年 WireGuard 也曾被移出 Play 商店。相关争议还涉及 Google 对“免税捐款”的表述，与 AnkiDroid 所属 501(c)(6) 组织捐款不可抵税之间的分歧。由于缺少完整的官方政策原文，具体条款和影响范围尚不完全明确。
items.background_zh: AnkiDroid 是 Anki 的 Android 开源实现，资金主要来自用户捐赠，通常通过 Open Collective 等平台募集。Open Collective 是面向开源项目的财务托管平台；AnkiDroid 所属组织为美国 501(c)(6) 组织，因此捐赠者捐款不像 501(c)(3) 慈善捐款那样可以抵税。Google Play 对应用内支付和外部捐赠链接的展示有严格限制，此次事件是这类平台政策在开源项目上的又一次体现。

items.title: ChatGPT Health adds Epic integration for clinicians to import patient data
items.content: OpenAI said that the integration provides read-only access to health records for clinicians.
items.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Health now integrates with Epic to give clinicians read-only access to patient records.
items.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI宣布旗下ChatGPT Health与电子病历系统Epic完成集成，为临床医生提供对患者健康记录的只读访问权限。借助这一集成，临床医生可以将患者数据导入ChatGPT Health，以便在临床工作流程中使用。该功能目前仅提供只读权限，具体支持范围、数据安全与合规细节尚未完全披露。此次更新属于医疗AI领域的增量产品整合，主要面向已使用Epic系统的医疗机构。
items.background_zh: Epic 是广泛应用于美国医疗机构的电子健康记录（EHR）系统，其数据覆盖超过 3.25 亿患者。OpenAI 将 ChatGPT Health（或称 ChatGPT for Healthcare）与 Epic 集成，为临床医生提供患者病历的只读访问权限，以便在 AI 辅助下提问和查看授权患者信息。旧金山的 UCSF Health 是此次集成的试点合作机构，OpenAI 还推出了医疗公共数据插件，帮助团队处理来自官方来源的结构化信息。

items.title: Hang on to Your Firefox
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[autoexec]: > Meanwhile, the over thinkers on Hacker News come up with convoluted reasons to hate on Firefox every time the subject arises...Firefox is our last best hope for browser engine diversity and competition. It's exactly because Firefox is so important that you'll see people here complaining when Firefox does things to push away users like Mozilla buying up an ad-tech company, collecting data on users, and using firefox to push personalized ads, or the addition of anti-features and ...

[roughly]: There’s an old mantra from organizing: “no permanent enemies, no permanent allies.” You will never align with another group or person 100% on all things; the secret to making change is to build a coalition of those with whom you agree on an issue without holding it against them that you disagree on a different one. I disagree with Mozilla about many things, but I agree with this article - I use Firefox because it’s the only browser out there that isn’t Chrome or WebKit, and that’s worth enoug...

[hx8]: I am under the impression that Firefox is the only web browser which has access to quality ad blocker.  Am I incorrect in this?  How is this not enough of a selling point for everyone to switch to it?

[Nail2680]: Firefox is the best of a bunch of bad options, but isn't above critique.  It does suck when they do anticonsumer stuff and shove weird stuff like pocket in, but you can't leave which makes it similar to the democratic party where you can't really do anything, but they keep making really poor decisions.

[gboss]: I'm an avid Firefox user, but it seems that Firefox keeps getting worse. Pages forever load, when the issue does not happen in Chrome. History gets corrupted. Claude wouldn't load consistently if I had more than one tab of claude opened internal tools that used to work fine and we haven't updated struggle. I don't know if it's me but it's certainly maddening, especially when I go to Chrome on the same laptop and it just loads.
items.summary: Argues that Firefox should be retained as the only viable non-Chrome/WebKit browser engine, despite Mozilla's flaws.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 一篇观点文章主张保留 Firefox，理由是它目前唯一实际可行的非 Chromium/WebKit 内核浏览器（使用 Gecko 引擎），即使 Mozilla 存在收购广告技术公司、数据收集、推广个性化广告等缺陷也不应放弃。作者认为浏览器引擎多样性对开放网络至关重要，而 Firefox 一旦消失会使 WebKit/Chromium 双寡头格局失去制衡。该文并非技术新进展，而是对 Firefox 生态角色的评论，并引发社区围绕忠诚与批评的讨论。
items.background_zh: 如今浏览器内核主要由 Google 主导的 Chromium、Apple 的 WebKit 和 Mozilla 的 Gecko 三大体系构成；Firefox 使用 Gecko，是其中唯一不基于 Chromium 或 WebKit 的主要浏览器。文章引用一句可追溯至 1512 年的德国谚语，提醒人们不要因 Mozilla 的争议行为或缺陷而放弃这个重要而独立的内核。社区讨论中也有人指出 Firefox 在隐私保护和广告拦截方面的价值，但也有人抱怨其内存占用、性能等问题。

items.title: How accurate have Ed Zitron's AI skeptic predictions been?
items.content:

[solid_fuel]: I would be interested in seeing a similar list of predictions from Altman, Amodei, etc with annotations about how many have come true.  Ed Zitron is a blow hard and frequently overstates things to the point where it is hard to take seriously, but so are the AI industry leaders. I have heard multiple breathless press releases warning that the end of white collar work is "just 6 months away" and that people not using the latest Mythos/Fable/Whatever model will be hopelessly ...

[pcstl]: Zitron has become the distorted reflection of the very AI boosters he criticizes and mocks. I think the worst thing that happened to him was AI skepticism becoming a  political position . This gave him a captive audience -  as long as he says what they want to hear , which means that he can  never ever  concede that he might have been wrong or that AI might actually be progressing or having successes. This is  not  conducive to good prediction long-term - rather it leads one to a state of cog...

[achompas]: One thing I’m observing in these comments is a willingness of folks to project their own predictions onto Ed’s statements when validating their plausibility. Eg. “I think he’s wrong about the timing but I do expect AI companies to go to zero.” You can do that, but then you’re no longer discussing his predictions. You’re discussing  your  predictions, and your own positioning. Those differ from Dan’s essay, which engages with the literal text of Ed’s numerous predictions during 2024 and 2025 w...

items.summary: How accurate have Ed Zitron's AI skeptic predictions been?
items.background_zh: 这篇文章讨论的是 AI 怀疑论者 Ed Zitron 的预测到底有多准确。社区评论指出，Zitron 已成为他所嘲讽的 AI 鼓吹者的扭曲镜像：当 AI 怀疑论变成一种政治立场后，他拥有了一群只听他想听的受众，也因此很难承认自己可能出错。与其他评论不同，文章据称逐字审视了 Zitron 在 2024 至 2025 年的大量预测，而不是泛泛而谈。
